description: Find institutions and companies in the Ukraine Money Register by name substring: named award-record recipients of Ukraine-division accounts (obligated by fund code, obligated and outlaid by class, place of performance) and DoD contracts whose own records mention Ukraine, grouped by parent as USAspending lists it. With include_loop (default true), loop companies show three records side by side, never added and with no causation: DoD Ukraine-mention contract obligations; connected-PAC contributions to federal candidate committees by cycle, with the top recipient committees named exactly as the FEC lists them, with party and office; and lobbying filings citing Ukraine bills, each with its all-issue amount. Corporate PAC money is voluntary contributions from people the PAC may solicit, not company treasury or contract money; the FEC's own explanations are quoted. No individual donors, and no withheld or individual award recipients. The published recipient list holds the largest named institutions only, so a non-match is not evidence that no award was made.

include_loop.description: Show the contracts, PAC and lobbying records side by side for loop companies (default true); never added.

q.description: Required case-insensitive institution or company name substring, at most 80 characters.
